items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VII, List of Answers on Topics 23:1
items.html: (To the question) Its phase of from-below-upward is called Yesodot of YESHSUT, which came out on the coarseness of phase one, whose level reaches to ZA, and its Guf expanded in the King of Yesod. And it is the phase of Ruach of ZA of the Neshama. (p. 527, Item 47)
